newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Top Glory to place 367 mln new shrs - source.
newsitem.headline: Top Glory to place 367 mln new shrs - source.

text.p: Top Glory International Holdings Ltd plans to place 366.926 million new shares at HK$1.63 per share to private investors, sources close to the deal said on Friday.
Proceeds raised from the issue would be used to buy property and hotel interests. Peregrine Capital was the underwriter of the issue, they said.
In addition to the issue, the controlling shareholder of Top Glory was considering subscribing to a number of new shares separately, but details were not yet available, sources said.
One source said the controlling shareholder was likely to subscribe to 289.5 million new shares at the same price.
Top Glory officials were not immediately available for comment.
In January, Top Glory said it was in talks to buy hotels in China from its controlling shareholder, Top Glory Holding Co Ltd.

Top Glory, which is indirectly controlled by China-backed China National Cereals Oil and Foodstuffs Import and Export Corp (Ceroil), is involved in property investment and food-related businesses. Its shares closed unchanged at HK$1.89 on Friday.
